places.coord_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim, address-level match (251 Leon Avenue)
places.note_en: Low-cost dental care for people on low income or income assistance; no crowns, bridges or dentures.
places.note_zh: 为低收入或领取救济者提供的低价牙科服务；不做牙冠、牙桥或假牙。
places.verify_notes: Charity clinic, not a public-health clinic. Hours and fees are not published on the page. A third-party summary gave '259B Leon Avenue' and toll-free 1-800-789-0680; the official page says 251 Leon Avenue and 250-763-3737 - official values used; confirm 250-763-3737 is the dental line and not the Mission's general line. Accepts government ministry dental coverage, Healthy Kids, PWD plans, FNHA. Alternatives: IH dental program at 505 Doyle Ave (children 0-6 only, 250-469-7070 ext 13301); Okanagan College student dental clinic (seasonal, May only).
